title: Cephalon Capture/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - Teshin: "In times of war, knowledge is the brightest blade. Capture your enemy's Cephalon while defending your own."
- Teshin: "Without intelligence, a vast enemy can be scattered. Defend your team's Cephalon. Capture the enemy's."
- Teshin: "Awareness and calculation are the tools of warfare. Capture your opponent's Cephalon. Protect your own."
- Teshin: "Sun is one point from victory."
- Teshin: "Moon is one point from victory."
- Teshin: "Sun's light has burned Moon's shadow away."
- Teshin: "The fires of the Sun have turned the Moon to ash."
- Teshin: "Moon was torn apart by Sun's furious light."
- Teshin: "Moon's surging tide washes away the Sun."
- Teshin: "The near Moon eclipses the far Sun."
- Teshin: "The oceans of Moon have extinguished the fire of Sun."
- Teshin: "Well earned, pupil. You fought with discipline and honor."
- Teshin: "With this victory your strength and reputation grows."
- Teshin: "Your enemies will remember this day with humiliation."
- Teshin: "You impress me, pupil. You are on your way to higher Mastery."
- Teshin: "This defeat is a lesson. Consider your mistakes. Study your enemy's movements. Grow from this moment on."
- Teshin: "Failure teaches us more than victory. Reflect on your movements and summon a greater resolve."
- Teshin: "The path to mastery has many setbacks. It is the true masters who remain unfaltering in their journey."
- Teshin: "The enemy is but a mountain. With each fall you test its surface, learning the footholds needed to reach the summit."
- Teshin: "The match ends in a draw."
- Teshin: "A stalemate between Sun and Moon."
- Teshin: "A deadlock between the Moon and Sun."
- Cephalon Apnar: "Cephalon Apnar is fine here. No chance to be stolen."
- Cephalon Apnar: "Don't worry Operators. Look around, enjoy the optical flow."
- Cephalon Apnar: "Defense not required! Cephalon Apnar is safe."
- Cephalon Apnar: "This is not boring at all. Cephalon Apnar would like to stay immobilized here forever."
- Cephalon Apnar: "Cephalon Apnar has been accused of wanting to be captured? No comment."
- Cephalon Apnar: "Well, it was movement while it lasted."
- Cephalon Apnar: "Oh good, I'm back where I started."
- Cephalon Apnar: "Back at base, Operators! Set systems to... tedium."
- Cephalon Apnar: "How will Cephalon Apnar ever be displaced with Operators like this?"
- Cephalon Apnar: "Ooh, you seem fast, show Cephalon Apnar!"
- Cephalon Apnar: "Oh, pleased to meet you. I will be your hostage today."
- Cephalon Apnar: "Apnar is free at last!"
- Cephalon Apnar: "Lookin' sharp. Is that a new Warframe?"
- Cephalon Apnar: "Ooh, this is nice. We should do this more often!"
- Cephalon Apnar: "(Giggles) You're tickling my gyroscopics; stop it!"
- Cephalon Apnar: "Cephalon Apnar should not be having fun, BUT IS!"
- Cephalon Apnar: "Ugly, ugly thing! You need to move!"
- Cephalon Apnar: "What are you doing? Come on, let's move!"
- Cephalon Apnar: "This is just as boring as the Operators' base!"
- Cephalon Apnar: "Drop me. Cephalon Apnar wants off!"
- Cephalon Apnar: "A sickening lack of movement!"

path: When the Holder Gets a Kill
lines: - Cephalon Apnar: "Hoh, what a relief! We can have more time together!"
- Cephalon Apnar: "Apnar is not one to judge."
- Cephalon Apnar: "You did what you had to; it makes you handsome!"

path: When the Holder Has Low Health
lines: - Cephalon Apnar: "Let me apologize for the Operators, they're being very nasty today."
- Cephalon Apnar: "Are you OK? Oh, if only Apnar could provide medical subroutines!"
- Cephalon Apnar: "Just a temporary set back on my locomotion!"
- Cephalon Apnar: "What a waste of good kinetics."

path: When Cephalon Is On Ground For A Long Time
lines: - Cephalon Apnar: "Operators? Cephalon Apnar appears to have stalled."
- Cephalon Apnar: "Cephalon Apnar wishes self-destruct was possible."
- Cephalon Apnar: "Apnar is inert. Motionless. Funless."

path: When Holder Reaches Enemy Base While Their Cephalon Is Stolen
lines: - Cephalon Apnar: "Oh, see, you cannot score without your own Cephalon in the 'Boredom' position."
- Cephalon Apnar: "Your missing Cephalon must be back here as well to score a point."

path: Stalement When Both Cephalons Are Stolen
lines: - Cephalon Apnar: "This is not boring at all."
- Cephalon Sark: "Cephalon Sark is nominal. Smiling."
- Cephalon Sark: "{Concerned look} Operators, do not allow Cephalon Sark to be stolen."
- Cephalon Sark: "Peel your eyes Operators. The fish could be near."
- Cephalon Sark: "Be vigilant Operators. Squinting, suspicious look."
- Cephalon Sark: "{Nervous thoughts} Beware the fish spawning."
- Cephalon Sark: "Olfactory sensors detecting fish people. Guard me!"
- Cephalon Sark: "Gleaming scales in the light. Gliding thieves through fluid air. Beware the fishes!"
- Cephalon Sark: "Cephalon Sark is where it should be! {Smile!}"
- Cephalon Sark: "{Delighted expression!} Returning to nominal!"
- Cephalon Sark: "{Relieved!} Operators have returned me!"
- Cephalon Sark: "{Look of gratitude} Operators perform well, catching fish."
- Cephalon Sark: "That was way too close. Keep your nets at the ready!"
- Cephalon Sark: "Nodding approval to the Operators for defending me."
- Cephalon Sark: "Reel them in Operators! {Nodding acknowledgement}"
- Cephalon Sark: "{Frown...} Cephalon Sark is in oily enemy hands!"
- Cephalon Sark: "Intruders! Cephalon Sark has been stolen! {Eyes wide!}"
- Cephalon Sark: "Cephalon Sark hates you and your fish face!"
- Cephalon Sark: "Operators! The fish are swimming away with me!"
- Cephalon Sark: "Fish creature! Release me! {Threatening expression...}"
- Cephalon Sark: "{Scowling at the fish creature.} You give me a disappointed face!"
- Cephalon Sark: "The Operators will come and peel off your reeking scales!"
- Cephalon Sark: "{Scowling at the cold fish!} You will be hooked soon enough!"
- Cephalon Sark: "{Looks daggers at you!} Fish thing!"
- Cephalon Sark: "Operators, Cephalon Sark is over here! Follow the smell!"
- Cephalon Sark: "Work your gills, fish thing! Let's get moving!"
- Cephalon Sark: "You cannot hide forever! Swish your scaly tail!"
- Cephalon Sark: "Your scent gives you away! Ugh! {Insulting smirk...}"

path: When the Holder Gets a Kill
lines: - Cephalon Sark: "Negative outcome, but the net is closing in."
- Cephalon Sark: "I hope you're {happy expression!} More Operators will come for me!"
- Cephalon Sark: "{Frowning.} You're a good thief, fish head."

path: When the Holder Has Low Health
lines: - Cephalon Sark: "Poor fish, Cephalon Sark hopes you don't die! {Fake smile!}"
- Cephalon Sark: "{Menacing laugh!} Operators are making progress!"
- Cephalon Sark: "{Contemptuous look.} The fish will soon be in the boat."
- Cephalon Sark: "This fish is almost out of the water! {Glaring eyes...}"
- Cephalon Sark: "{Smug look!} Serves you right!"
- Cephalon Sark: "Slippery fish have failed! Cephalon Sark smirking!"
- Cephalon Sark: "Finally! Now for immediate decontamination."

path: When Cephalon Is On Ground For A Long Time
lines: - Cephalon Sark: "Operators, {Longing expression} don't forget me!"
- Cephalon Sark: "{Look of longing} Cephalon Sark is lost Operators!"
- Cephalon Sark: "{Anxious} Cephalon Sark requires the comfort of base position!"

path: When Holder Reaches Enemy Base While Their Cephalon Is Stolen
lines: - Cephalon Sark: "Fish brain confused? Your team's Cephalon must be home to score."
- Cephalon Sark: "{Rolling eyes!} You need your Cephalon to get a point, gill-mouth."

path: Stalement When Both Cephalons Are Stolen
lines: - Cephalon Sark: "{Looks daggers at you!} Fish thing!"
- Cephalon Sark: "You give me a disappointed face!"
- Cephalon Vull: "Cephalon Vull is at base. Yay!"
- Cephalon Vull: "Best of luck to the Operators on a bloody resolution to this conflict."
- Cephalon Vull: "Vull cherishes all Operators. I can rip off your arms to see the rainbows inside."
- Cephalon Vull: "Vull's head is in the game. Do I have a head?"
- Cephalon Vull: "Vull is back! Did I miss anything gory?"
- Cephalon Vull: "Vull saw many terrible scenes of anguish. What a time to be self aware!"
- Cephalon Vull: "Back at base! Excellent! This is where the Operators fight most!"
- Cephalon Vull: "Cephalon Vull is ready for more Operators! More please!"
- Cephalon Vull: "Good teamwork everyone! What a beautiful corpse!"
- Cephalon Vull: "That was very violent and very dangerous. Good job."
- Cephalon Vull: "Announcing a new hands off policy. Tear them right off!"
- Cephalon Vull: "Unnecessarily aggressive. Vull will savor this moment."
- Cephalon Vull: "Do you need a time-out in the choices chair?"
- Cephalon Vull: "You are so cute! I want to hug you until your organs rupture!"
- Cephalon Vull: "You're good at this; Vull will enjoy watching you die!"
- Cephalon Vull: "Look at you, I could just squeeze your shiny face until your skull collapses!"
- Cephalon Vull: "Return me, and my Operators will forgive you – with their guns!"
- Cephalon Vull: "Watch out for pits and gunfire! I 'wouldn't' want to see you get hurt."
- Cephalon Vull: "All I want is a piece of you... to tear off and keep forever!"
- Cephalon Vull: "Vull thinks you have a kind heart. Let's take it out and see!"
- Cephalon Vull: "Good idea! Let's wait here and hope for... snipers!"
- Cephalon Vull: "Vull wonders if you feel safer here. Let's hope not!"
- Cephalon Vull: "Operators are looking for me. They just want to 'talk' to you regarding my release."
- Cephalon Vull: "Time is not healing your wounds! That's exciting!"

path: When the Holder Gets a Kill
lines: - Cephalon Vull: "It's not your corpse, but I guess it will do."
- Cephalon Vull: "What a waste of good suffering..."
- Cephalon Vull: "You didn't even try negotiation! Vull approves."
- Cephalon Vull: "Oh my, violently lashing out? Vull may have... feelings for you."

path: When the Holder Has Low Health
lines: - Cephalon Vull: "That was close! Vull is disappointed..."
- Cephalon Vull: "You almost died back there! Vull is having fun!"
- Cephalon Vull: "Dear me, your life juice is leaking out..."
- Cephalon Vull: "Vull does not blame you... just kidding."
- Cephalon Vull: "Oh no! Vull thinks your suffering could have been much more prolonged."
- Cephalon Vull: "Hoorah! Operators! What an excessive use of force!"

path: When Cephalon Is On Ground For A Long Time
lines: - Cephalon Vull: "Operators, over here! Come fight over me!"
- Cephalon Vull: "Vull better not miss any violent rampages."
- Cephalon Vull: "Luckily someone broke my morality system. I hope they die."

path: When Holder Reaches Enemy Base While Their Cephalon Is Stolen
lines: - Cephalon Vull: "Vull reminds you: You cannot score if your Cephalon is taken."
- Cephalon Vull: "No scoring is possible unless your Cephalon is also returned."
- Cephalon Vull: "Useless waiting here if your Cephalon is missing. Let's look for trouble!"

path: Stalement When Both Cephalons Are Stolen
lines: - Cephalon Vull: "I wouldn't want to see you get hurt."
- Cephalon Vull: "Vull will enjoy watching you die."
